title: The projection-pair count statistic: r=4 exact bijection over the full 2^32 coset, and the r=5 residue claim
preregistration: count5/PREREGISTRATION.md, written before measurement, with derived predictions n_r4=0 and n_r5 = 0 mod 8.

r4_exact_bijection.reading: Over the FULL 2^32 coset, the projection is a bijection: every bucket occupied exactly once, zero colliding pairs. This is exhaustive over the tested space, not a sample, so it has no detection floor.

r5_residue.why_it_is_only_analyzed: A residue mod 8 read on a small number of trials has a 1-in-8 per-trial probability under the uniform null. The package's own r=6 addendum demonstrates the hazard by recording a single r=6 trial that also read 0 and ruling it a coincidence rather than a property.
r5_residue.what_would_settle_it: A matched random-permutation control on the SAME statistic. If a random permutation also reads 0 mod 8, the residue is an artifact of the counting rather than a distinguisher, and the claim collapses. That control is the priority item on the independent validator's card (TASK-20260802-907).

r6.ruling: The three independent readings 7, 4, 0 are consistent with the uniform null. The 0 reading is recorded as a 1-in-8 coincidence, NOT as the property surviving a round deeper.
r6.why_this_is_in_the_record: That reading would have been the most significant claim in this campaign if reported alone. It is written down as a near-miss precisely because it was not.

invalid_measurements.reading: Recorded as invalid rather than dropped. An overflowed counter is not a measurement.

r=3 exact positive control at full width
identity cross-check on every arm (a second independent count of the same statistic), agreeing on all valid arms
controls_NOT_run: MATCHED RANDOM-PERMUTATION NULL on the mod-8 statistic. THIS IS THE LOAD-BEARING GAP and it is stated as untested, not assumed favourable.
Component nulls (random bijective S-box, identity MixColumns) on this statistic.
scope: AES-128, r in {2,3,4,5,6}, the pinned reduced-round convention, one projection word family. The r=4 bijection is exhaustive over the tested coset; the r=5 residue is not yet a property.

inference.fallback_note: orchestration/model-policies.yaml names a GPT-5.6-family alias that this harness cannot resolve; all roles run model: inherit here.
